caveats: Timing labels are provisional: 20 press releases were looked up and every other event keeps the calendar's label (not_checked) until SEC EDGAR is set up, so a few events may sit on the wrong day 0. Every number here depends on those labels.

Holm runs over H1, H2, H3, H4, H5, H6, H7 (7 hypotheses). H5 (9.55%), H6 (8.10%), H7 (16.15%) failed gate G1's regression size check, which ran before their results were computed: their statistics are liberal on this design, so a rejection by them would not be trusted. They stay in the declared family with their real p-values (ADR 0005 §5, dated note of 2026-10-29); their rows are in drivers.json. Sensitivity, not binding: over the family without them (H1, H2, H3, H4) the Holm p would be H1 2.32e-22, H2 0.02344, H3 1.0, H4 1.0, H2's season cut 0.04688.
Primary rows are equal-weighted means of market-adjusted abnormal log IV (VIX, beta per company). Precision-weighted rows (BMP, KP, KPP, Patell) test another estimand and are robustness only.
Market-adjusted numbers are aggregates of values computed with the Cboe VIX index (via FRED VIXCLS); see DATA.md for Cboe's terms.

Gate G1's calibrated design finds these robustness rows oversized (rejection rate under the null above the band's upper edge for the replications it was measured on: 6.30% at 2,000, 5.57% at 10,000): H1 bmp_t 27.55%; H1 cluster_date_t 25.15%; H1 gen_sign_z 21.90%; H1 kp_ow_t 17.40%; H1 kpp_t 17.55%; H1 patell_z 65.75%; H1 rank_t 39.45%; H4 gen_sign_z 5.68% (on 10,000); H4 rank_t 13.65%; H5 cluster_date_t 18.45%; H5 twoway_date_t:mean_adj 9.65%; H6 cluster_date_t 20.10%; H6 twoway_date_t:mean_adj 8.35%; H7 cluster_date_wald 17.00%. As ADR 0005 §4 does for rows known to be mis-sized, their p-values and intervals are withheld (null; g1_size and g1_reps give the rate and its replications instead) and their estimates are shown.

Robustness rates within one point of the 6.30% bar on 2,000 replications are re-measured on more replications and decided against that count's bar (ADR 0005 §4): H4 bmp_t 5.34% on 10,000, p-value kept; H4 cluster_date_t 4.98% on 10,000, p-value kept; H4 gen_sign_z 5.68% on 10,000, withheld.
